scope: Separate the calendar card from the top panel by six logical pixels.

checks.command: Open the panel clock in a disposable KDE neon Wayland guest and capture the installed baseline and candidate. Verify the candidate QML SHA-256, a 328 by 328 card and popup height increasing from 328 to 334 logical pixels.
Check the immutable published Tahoe archive SHA-256 and compare its calendar QML and version with the approved release.

coverage_limits: Dark Tahoe calendar on KDE neon Wayland at 2x scale. Golden Gate uses the shared QML.
approval: Maintainer approved publication of the before-and-after preview.
